patch_description:
Replace the unconstrained Gaussian cloud with a deterministic numerical construction of a 14-point spherical code.  The 14 points are built as seven optimized unit directions together with their antipodes.  This guarantees a positive maximum distance of exactly 2, while minimizing the largest absolute inner product between distinct directions maximizes the minimum chordal distance.

The optimization uses several fixed-seed restarts and projected gradient descent on a progressively sharpened soft maximum of squared pairwise inner products.  Normalizing every iteration keeps all directions on the unit sphere, and selecting the best restart according to the actual maximum absolute inner product makes the returned construction deterministic and directly aligned with the evaluator objective.
